_meta.description: Biome colours for the tfc-1.20 profile's biome raster layer and legend. This is our own UI design choice, not a port of any Java source: colours are grouped by terrain character so the map reads intuitively — blues for ocean/lake/river (darker with depth), sand/olive for coasts, greens for vegetated lowlands and hills, orange/red for dry canyons and badlands, and grey tones (tinted by kind) for mountains. Every id here is ported game data from src/data/tfc-1.20/biomes.json (net.dries007.tfc.world.layer.TFCLayers's biome registration, see src/worldgen/tfc-1.20/biome/ids.ts) — only the colour assigned to each id is a design decision. Packed as 0xRRGGBB decimal, matching src/render/colormap.ts's colorToCss.
